title: 第5章 踏入后天
slug: 武破九荒全本免费-武破九荒最新章节列表
content_zh:
噗！噗！
萧叶身影闪动间，破风阵阵。
随着萧叶的苦练，他体内的血气翻滚不息，游走全身，凝练着身体，使得他的实力慢慢提升着，达到炼体九重后期。
他已经在时间之塔第一层，修炼了整整三百天了。按照第一层的时间流速，这也就是说，外界才过去一个月而已。
如果外人得知，只过去了一个月，萧叶的实力就突破到炼体九重后期，一定会非常震惊的。
如今，萧叶已经完全适应了时间之塔的环境。
在这里，他感受不到饥饿，除了休息外，他所有的时间都拿来修炼了。
萧叶能感觉到，自己只是意识进入了时间之塔，肉身还留在外界，他甚至能隐隐听到父母的呼唤。
而他只要一动念头，就能回归肉身。
但在确认了，意识在这里修炼，和肉身修炼无异后，萧叶便断绝了苏醒的念头。
“爹，娘，等孩儿突破到后天境，再向你们赔罪！”萧叶脸上扬起一缕倔强的神情。
深刻认识到自己与赵乾的巨大差距后，他不想浪费一点时间。
况且，重阳门入门考核迫近，他只有突破到后天境，才有机会通过。
时间之塔第一层，少年挥洒汗水，不断的施展着猛虎拳，他对这套基础战技的感悟，不断的加深着。
三百天不停的苦练，这种效果是极为惊人的。
萧叶宛若一头猛虎在腾跃，举手投足，都有劲气环绕四周。
在不知道练习了多少次后，萧叶一拳蓦然轰出，拳锋上劲道融合，化作一个狰狞的虎头，引发声震四野的虎啸之声。
嘭嘭嘭！
那狰狞的虎头才一形成，便直扑前方，引发连环气爆，在虚空中拉出一条气浪，然后才缓缓消失。
“这……这是山叔曾提过的猛虎拳势！”萧叶呆住了，满脸的不可置信。

萧大山第一次传授他们猛虎拳的时候，就曾说过，猛虎拳虽然只是基础战技，但是一些天才武者，修炼到极为高深的地步，可以领悟出猛虎拳势。
猛虎拳势一出，整合全身劲道爆发攻击，威力甚至可以和一品战技比肩。
但是能领悟出猛虎拳势的武者，万中无一。
萧家村的武者，都修炼过猛虎拳，但包括萧大山和村长在内，都没有领悟出猛虎拳势。
“如果我能掌握猛虎拳势，那我踏入后天境的时间，将大大缩短！”萧叶眼中闪现兴奋的光芒。
他以练习猛虎拳来炼体，当猛虎拳威力提升，他炼体速度也将随之增加。
“不对，找不到那种感觉了。”练习了几次后，萧叶眉头一皱。
在尝试了五百次后，他再次找到感觉，打出了猛虎拳势。
“我一定要掌握猛虎拳势！”萧叶表情坚定，不断的练习着。
这次，他只是尝试了三百次，就打出了猛虎拳势。
又在时间之塔苦练了半个月，他终于彻底掌握了猛虎拳势，一拳轰出，引发虎啸震天。
萧叶随意一拳，都有猛虎拳势伴随，使得他体内的气血急速涌动着，淬炼四肢百骸，炼体速度至少达到了以前的五倍以上。
这种日益强大的感觉，让萧叶迷醉。
“还有两个月，就是年关了，我要在此之前，突破到后天境，给爹娘一个惊喜。”萧叶满脸的自信。
外界两个月，在时间之塔第一层也就是六百天。领悟了猛虎拳势后，萧叶有十足的信心，在年关之前突破到后天境。
年关代表着一年的结束，是青阳镇的盛事。同时，那天各个村子的少年少女会聚在一起，进行选婚，选择一生的伴侣。
而那一天，也代表着萧叶，将步入十五岁了。
十五岁的后天境……
萧叶只要想到，心底便一阵兴奋。
十五岁踏入后天境，别说萧家村了，就算纵观青阳镇的历史，也没有出现过，比之那些大家族的子弟，恐怕也丝毫不弱。

如果村民们看到他突破到后天境，会露出怎样精彩的表情？萧叶很期待。
“继续修炼！”萧叶将杂念抛之脑后，再次修炼起来。
死寂的空间中，唯有少年的身影在闪动着，无匹的猛虎拳势爆发，声震四野！
时值深冬，天空下起了鹅毛大雪，将整个青阳镇，披上了一层银装。
虽然天气寒冷，但是镇子上的气氛却异常火热，因为青阳镇即将迎来年关。
这一天，青阳镇中但凡年满十四岁的少年少女，都会走出村子，挑选自己中意的伴侣。青阳镇是贫瘠之地，只能村子与村子之间联婚。

content_en:
puff! puff!
As Xiao Ye's figure flashed, bursts of wind broke through.
As Xiao Ye trained hard, the blood in his body kept rolling, traveling throughout his body, condensing his body, causing his strength to slowly increase, reaching the late stage of the ninth level of body refining.
He has been practicing on the first floor of the Tower of Time for three hundred days. According to the time flow rate on the first level, this means that only one month has passed in the outside world.
If outsiders knew that only one month had passed, Xiao Ye's strength had broken through to the late ninth level of body refining, they would be very shocked.
Now, Xiao Ye has completely adapted to the environment of the Tower of Time.
Here, he couldn't feel hunger. Apart from resting, he spent all his time practicing.
Xiao Ye could feel that he had only entered the Tower of Time with his consciousness, and his physical body was still in the outside world. He could even faintly hear the calls of his parents.
And he can return to his physical body with just a thought.
But after confirming that the cultivation of consciousness here is no different from the cultivation of the physical body, Xiao Ye gave up the idea of ​​awakening.
"Father, mother, wait until the child breaks through to the acquired realm before I apologize to you!" A stubborn look appeared on Xiao Ye's face.
After deeply realizing the huge gap between himself and Zhao Qian, he didn't want to waste any time.
Moreover, the Chongyang Sect entrance examination is approaching, and he will have a chance to pass only if he breaks through to the Houtian realm.
On the first floor of the Tower of Time, the young man was sweating and constantly performing the Tiger Fist. His understanding of this set of basic combat skills continued to deepen.
After three hundred days of hard training, this effect is extremely amazing.
Xiao Ye was like a ferocious tiger prancing around, with energy surrounding him in every move and every move he made.
After practicing for an unknown number of times, Xiao Ye suddenly punched out, and the strength of the punch fused together, turning into a ferocious tiger head, causing a roar that shook the whole country.
Bang bang bang!
As soon as the ferocious tiger head was formed, it rushed forward, triggering a series of air explosions, pulling out a wave of air in the void, and then slowly disappeared.
"This...this is the Tiger Fist that Uncle Shan once mentioned!" Xiao Ye was stunned, his face full of disbelief.
When Xiao Dashan taught them the Tiger Fist for the first time, he once said that although the Tiger Fist is only a basic combat skill, some talented warriors who have practiced to an extremely advanced level can understand the Tiger Fist.
As soon as the Tiger Fist comes out, it integrates all the strength of the whole body to explode into an attack, and its power can even rival that of a first-grade combat skill.
But there is only one warrior in a million who can comprehend the fierce tiger fist.
The warriors in Xiaojia Village have all practiced the Tiger Fist, but none of them, including Xiao Dashan and the village chief, have understood the power of the Tiger Fist.
"If I can master the Tiger Fist, the time it takes me to enter the acquired realm will be greatly shortened!" Xiao Ye's eyes flashed with excitement.
He trains his body by practicing the Tiger Fist. When the power of the Tiger Fist increases, the speed of his body training will also increase.
"No, I can't find that feeling anymore." After practicing a few times, Xiao Ye frowned.
After trying five hundred times, he found the feeling again and hit the tiger fist.
"I must master the Tiger Fist!" Xiao Ye had a firm expression and kept practicing.
This time, he only tried three hundred times before he hit the tiger fist.
After another half month of hard training at the Tower of Time, he finally mastered the Tiger Fist and punched out, causing the tiger to roar and shake the sky.
Xiao Ye's casual punch was accompanied by the fierce tiger fist, causing the blood and energy in his body to surge rapidly, tempering his limbs and bones, and the body refining speed was at least five times faster than before.
This increasingly powerful feeling made Xiao Ye intoxicated.
"There are still two months until the New Year is over. I want to break through to the acquired realm before then and give my parents a surprise." Xiao Ye's face was full of confidence.
Two months in the outside world is six hundred days on the first floor of the Tower of Time. After understanding the Tiger Fist, Xiao Ye has full confidence to break through to the Houtian realm before the end of the year.
The New Year's Eve represents the end of the year and is the symbol of Qingyang Town.grand event. At the same time, on that day, boys and girls from various villages will gather together to choose a lifelong partner.
And that day also means that Xiao Ye will be fifteen years old.
The acquired state of fifteen years old...
As long as Xiao Ye thought about it, he would feel excited in his heart.
Entering the Houtian realm at the age of fifteen, let alone Xiaojia Village, even if we look at the history of Qingyang Town, it has never appeared before. Compared with the children of those big families, I am afraid that it is not weak at all.
What kind of wonderful expressions would the villagers show if they saw him breaking through to the acquired realm? Xiao Ye is looking forward to it.
"Continue to practice!" Xiao Ye put aside his distracting thoughts and started practicing again.
In the dead silence, only the young man's figure was flashing, and the unparalleled tiger fist burst out, making the sound shake the whole world!
It was late winter, and heavy snow fell from the sky, covering the entire Qingyang Town with a layer of silver.
Although the weather is cold, the atmosphere in the town is extremely hot because Qingyang Town is about to usher in the New Year.
On this day, all the boys and girls in Qingyang Town who are over fourteen years old will go out of the village and choose their favorite partner. Qingyang Town is a barren land where marriages can only occur between villages.
